name: Redcaps
description: Malicious goblins of Shadowmoor and Eldraine who dye caps red with blood.

timeline.summary: The dwarf-redcap feud boils over in the Assault on Delverhaugh.
timeline.quote: The feud boiled over in a massive food fight known as the Assault on Delverhaugh

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Goddric reveals his true identity and douses redcap invaders in dragonfire when a redcap raid threatens the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh.
timeline.quote: When a redcap raid threatened the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh, Goddric had no choice but to reveal his true identity and douse the invaders in dragonfire.

citation.text: Expel the Interlopers (Wilds of Eldraine Promos, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dwarves fight the redcaps with anything within reach.
timeline.quote: With no time to gather weapons, the dwarves fought the redcaps with anything within reach.

citation.text: Food Fight (Wilds of Eldraine Promos, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dwarven survivors are dubbed the Gluttoneers for slaying redcaps with fruit and cakes.
timeline.quote: the dwarven survivors were dubbed the Gluttoneers.

citation.text: Raid Bombardment (Wilds of Eldraine: Enchanting Tales, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Long feud, sparked by a dispute over a spoon.
relations.quote: The feud between dwarves and redcaps had raged for so long that no one could quite recall how it started.

citation.text: Shared Animosity (Wilds of Eldraine: Enchanting Tales, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Raiders who threatened the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh and fought dwarves.
